article.para: Every file, its purpose, key functions
"You can only do what you can do when you can do it."
article.sect1:
Core Files — /home/seven/swarm/Core Files — /home/seven/swarm/
File
Purpose
config.py
All secrets, API keys, system prompts. NEVER SHARE. NEVER PRINT.
database.py
Complete database layer. 22 tables. Run once to initialise: python3 database.py
listener.py
Email loop. IMAP poll every 60s. Entry point for email pipeline.
orchestrator.py
Agent pipeline. Gemma routes. Agents run. Gemma synthesises. FL-001.
eight.py
Eight SAP specialist. Three-voice pipeline. Tavily SAP search. Gemma synthesis.
claude_api.py
Ghost Circle advisor. Gemma calls Claude when stuck. Response cached.
duck.py
Sanity checker. YES/NO after every ticket. Runs inside librarian_close.
sniffer.py
Memory auditor. PASS/WARN/FLAG. Runs when queue quiet or Duck flagged.
queue_manager.py
Librarian intake layer. Owns queue table. Tags, queues, manages position.
ticket.py
Ticket lifecycle. create → close. Librarian owns close. Duck runs inside.
terminal.py
Swarm terminal web UI. Flask. Port 5050. SSE streaming. Kill switches.
simulate.py
Dry-run simulation. 3 fake tickets through full pipeline. No email sent.
monitor.py
System stats daemon. Daily report to Ghost. get_system_status() callable.
internet.py
LLaMA DuckDuckGo search. No API key needed.
internet_serper.py
Gemma Google search via Serper.dev. SERPER_API_KEY in config.
internet_tavily.py
Qwen/Eight Tavily AI search. TAVILY_API_KEY in config. search_sap() for Eight.
sandpits.py
Sandpit filesystem. Trust level enforcement. sandpit_log. Sniffles-callable.
eight_memory.py
Eight knowledge loader. seed/teach/correct/list modes.
email_handler.py
Gmail IMAP/SMTP. Fetch unread, mark as read, send reply.
email_cleaner.py
Strip signatures, reply chains, subject prefixes. Subject prepended to question.
debate.py
Three-round debate. Qwen challenges LLaMA R2. Gemma judges.
housekeeping.py
Daily cleanup. Archive low-importance memories.
contradiction_check.py
Compare new agent memories against verified Gemma facts.
killswitch.sh
Stop all swarm services instantly.
startswarm.sh
Start core swarm services.
swarm_memory.db
SQLite database. 22 tables. All memory lives here.
VS_CODE_CONTEXT.md
VS Code context brief — first file to show new Claude sessions.
CLAUDE_CODE_HANDOVER.md
Technical handover brief for Claude Code sessions.
PROJECT.md
The coder's bible. When this diverges from code, the code is wrong.

Environment VariablesEnvironment Variables
Add to /etc/environment then reboot or source /etc/environment:
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-...
SERPER_API_KEY=...
⚠ API keys must be in /etc/environment — never in config.py. config.py is NEVER shared or printed.
